content.title: Inspect the header global search field before and after direct focus
content.intent: Prove the centered header search field shows the promised placeholder, gains the promised focus affordances, and keeps its 420px by 36px footprint when focused.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning because direct focus is a distinct entry path into the field. Applied state/flow because the path compares unfocused and focused field states. Applied responsiveness/layout-stability reasoning because the PRD promises the field remains visually stable when focused. Boundary value analysis was not applicable because the PRD gives fixed dimensions, not an input range. Risk-judged combinatorial strength was 2 because only user-reach applied, but no covering_array expansion was needed because there are no combinable variable inputs for this path.
